summary: Jefferies Credit Partners BDC Inc., a non-traded Maryland BDC, filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 announcing a routine quarterly distribution. On September 29, 2026, the board declared $0.1126 per Class I common share and $0.1124 per Class S share, the latter net of a $0.0100 shareholder servicing/distribution fee, payable October 20, 2026 to holders of record September 30, 2026, in cash or via the distribution reinvestment plan. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, strategic review, or management change is involved; no deal terms apply. Watch for NAV and distribution-rate trends typical of BDC periodic reporting.
